clusters.title: Jensen Huang and Nvidia Scandal
clusters.summary: Nvidia is facing major political and financial turbulence following a scandal involving Jensen Huang, which has wiped out over a trillion dollars in value. The fallout has sparked political vulnerabilities for figures like Donald Trump and prompted leadership shakeups at the company.

clusters.title: Nationwide Flight Disruptions
clusters.summary: Thousands of flights have been canceled due to a nationwide ground stop, creating massive travel chaos across the country. The disruptions are forcing athletic teams, fans, and everyday travelers to scramble for alternative arrangements.

clusters.title: Measles Outbreaks and Health Concerns
clusters.summary: Surging measles cases are forcing doctors to treat unfamiliar conditions as the disease gains a foothold in multiple states, leading to rising fatalities and health warnings. Meanwhile, medical researchers have made new breakthroughs regarding Alzheimer's prediction, aging, and rare disorders.

clusters.title: Sports and Entertainment Highlights
clusters.summary: The sports world is navigating rescheduled games due to travel delays alongside major MMA and football matchups. In entertainment, upcoming releases like GTA 6 continue to generate immense buzz across gaming, streaming, and pop culture.

global_summary: Today's news is dominated by massive nationwide travel disruptions caused by a widespread ground stop affecting thousands of flights. Simultaneously, major corporate and political fallout continues to unfold around Nvidia and its leadership scandal. On the health front, medical professionals are sounding the alarm over surging measles outbreaks while researchers share new breakthroughs in disease detection.
